description:
•	Perform data analysis to support operational monitoring, performance tracking and business reporting.
•	Prepare and maintain reports communicating operational performance and key business metrics.
•	Develop and update interactive Power BI dashboards for data visualisation and performance monitoring.
•	Use Microsoft Excel and Power BI to organise, analyse and interpret business data.
•	Support KPI monitoring to identify operational trends, performance gaps and areas requiring improvement.
•	Provide analytical and reporting support to improve visibility into business operations and inform decision-making.
